policy: Catalogue reusable on-device and embedded intelligence: models, runtimes, toolkits and relevant primitives. Separate pretrained models, training-only architectures and hosted-only services. Prefer primary repository evidence. Keep code and weights licences distinct. Do not infer hardware compatibility, offline operation, RAM, latency or benchmark results. Never label a documentation review as a local test. Unknowns stay unknown. Generated assessments are review dossiers, not canonical catalogue edits or endorsements.
